Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Fremont Slatted 2-Door Cabinet, 31.5"W, Ash
Colors: Ash
Materials: Wood
31.5”W x 15.75”D x 31.7”H Solid ash frame and legs are complemented by hardwood doors with ash veneer A handsome piece that can anchor a modern, rustic or transitional style room or hallway Display photos or a vase of flowers on top; store books or other items inside Assembly in 15 minutes or less. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This simple, beautifully designed cabinet provides storage space as well as a handsome complement to modern, transitional or rustic décor. The vertical pieces of solid ashwood on the front of the drawer and doors add visual interest.
